name: status
description: Read health, position and current task.

name: inv
description: Read inventory and tool, food and space hints.

name: changes
description: Read state changes since this connection's last changes call.

name: memory
description: Read remembered container contents; optionally filter items.

name: inspect
description: Resolve an observed object ref to its exact block and supported actions, without moving or opening it.

name: menu
description: Read the currently open player menu: id, slots, cursor and synchronized data values (progress/energy where supplied by the menu). Open through use ref first. An open storage-network terminal adds a network section: exact stored amounts (craftable-only keys listed apart), or pending/disconnected/empty; filter narrows it, page continues a long list and fails when the network changed. Does not reveal closed storage.

name: encode_pattern
description: On an open pattern encoding terminal (use its ref first), encode a crafting pattern for an item from the game's own recipe, using a blank pattern from the inventory or terminal, and take the encoded pattern into the inventory.

name: speak
description: Internal (brain voice): play a 16-bit mono WAV, base64, from the bot through voice chat.

name: heard
description: Internal (brain voice): show a player what the bot understood from their voice.

name: job
description: Read a saved unfinished transfer job. action forget explicitly abandons its bookkeeping; real cargo stays in inventory. Only forget when the player asks to abandon/reconcile it.

name: menu_click
description: Click a slot in the currently open menu through player code; menu_id guards stale screens. click: pickup, quick_move or button. Mouse button 0/1; button mode uses the menu button id. Wait three ticks between clicks; inspect afterward.

name: transfer
description: Move ALL contents from source ref to destination ref through menu clicks and repeated trips. Keeps owned items. Success confirms source empty; failures report partial delivery. Use look stations or inspect to identify refs.

name: look
description: Return the scene; recent nearby looks use one frontal frame, fresh forces a 360 degree turn; optional focus: trees, ores, water, danger, built, stations, food.

name: scene
description: Read the remembered scene instantly, without turning; delta gives one line of changes.

name: map
description: Read the map: a 9x9 grid of 16-block cells around you, known places (structures v#, caves k# with entrances) and creatures within 48 blocks (e#) at their live positions, even behind walls; optional focus: a type, cave, structure or ref. Ores are not on the map.

name: locate
description: Full perception: the nearest blocks of an id or #tag (ores, logs, chests, machines, anything) through walls in loaded chunks, and which containers or machines around hold an item, with coordinates. Read-only; radius default 96, max 192.

name: explore
description: Walk through observed safe space toward a frontier, then look and report new objects.

name: knowledge
description: Read ore heights, frequency, biome restrictions, harvest tool and loot from server data.

name: wiki
description: Read in-game guides/quests/tooltips; use before crafting unfamiliar modded items.

name: explore_caves
description: Explore a seen cave mouth or dark opening, follow safe observed frontiers, gather target wall ore and place owned torches in darkness; return along breadcrumbs after five minutes or enough drops. Without cave, a fresh look then the nearest map cave entrance; cave k# (from map) walks into that cave first.

name: mine_ore
description: Descend to a known ore peak, bypass observed fluids, then mine a main tunnel and side branches until count or a ten minute budget; progress reports depth and actual drops.

name: obtain
description: Acquire a TOTAL count, including owned: inventory, remembered containers, supported crafting/smelting and survival sources; prepares needed tools. source world = mine/smelt/craft it yourself and never take from chests (use it for find/mine/добудь/накопай requests); any (default) may withdraw from remembered chests. Unsupported machine/network recipes return a blocker; plan and wiki explain dependencies.

name: plan
description: Plan recipes without acting; mode craft makes new items, get counts owned items.

name: come
description: Walk near an online player in the same dimension.

name: follow
description: Follow a player until stopped or replaced by another task.

name: give
description: Walk next to a player and toss owned items to them; item or all, omitted count means all matching items. Does not obtain items.

name: drop
description: Toss owned items where you stand; item or all, omitted count means all matching items.

name: goto
description: Walk to a ref: observed object (to the ground beside a building), map place v#/k# (cave entrance), creature e#, item i#, a player name; or exact block coordinates; never invent coordinates.

name: descend
description: Dig a safe 1-wide, 2-high staircase down to y; optional cardinal direction, otherwise facing. Requires a pickaxe for stone.

name: tunnel
description: Dig a safe 1x2 tunnel at this level and report uncovered ores with refs. Requires a pickaxe for stone.

name: mine
description: Walk to and mine one block, then collect its drops; needs a suitable tool.

name: gather
description: Harvest ONE observed thing: gather {ref} with a t#/s#/o# ref (or the player's pointed p#) and no count chops that whole tree or object, then stops. With count, or with logs/wood, stone/cobblestone, coal, iron, dirt, sand or an item id, gathers that many more. Remembered refs are revisited and reobserved; requires the right tool.

name: use
description: Walk to and right-click an observed ref or exact block; sneak bypasses block interactions.

name: attack
description: Hunt a creature by ref e# (from map or look), type or player name: chase its live position, fight with the best weapon, retreat when overwhelmed, then pick up its drops; reports killed (with drops) or lost.

name: pickup
description: Pick up dropped items within 24 blocks: an item ref i# (from map or look), an item id, or all when omitted. Kills already collect their own drops.

name: eat
description: Eat one inventory food through player use; omitted item selects safe nutritious food.

name: place
description: Place an inventory block, or any item that goes on by right-click (cables, pipes, parts), at x y z; optional face: up/down/north/south/east/west. If x y z is already occupied (a cable) and the item is a part (terminal, bus), it is attached to that block's given face. Sneaks automatically.

name: craft
description: Craft a count of NEW items; look for stations first and read missing-material hints.

name: get
description: Obtain at least count items, counting inventory and remembered sources.

name: look-in
description: Open a container by ref or coordinates, report its visible contents and close it. A storage-network terminal reports the network contents.

name: deposit
description: Put items into a container; filter is item id, #tag, loot (everything except your tools, weapons, armor and food: use it for 'put everything away'), all (literally everything) or junk; omitted count means all. A storage-network terminal takes them into the network; a full network reports what was moved.

name: withdraw
description: Take items from a container through menu clicks; omitted count means all matching items. Works on a storage-network terminal (exact count, network items only).

name: autocraft
description: Ask a storage network to craft items it has a pattern for, through its terminal (ref or x, y, z) like a player: the network plans and runs the job. Reports submitted or what the network is short of; withdraw the result later.

name: stop
description: Cancel the current action immediately.

name: say
description: Say one short message to all players as this bot.
